summary: Comprehensive testing of BITSAT Mock Test application completed successfully. All backend APIs (11/11 tests passed) and frontend UI features working perfectly. Complete end-to-end testing of 130-question mock test with 5 sections, timer, navigation, and results functionality.
passed_tests: Start screen displays BITS Pilani and Edu9 logos correctly
Test information shows 130 questions, 3 hours duration, 390 max marks
All 5 sections displayed with correct question counts (Physics-30, Chemistry-30, English-10, Logical-20, Mathematics-40)
Marking scheme (+3/-1/0) displayed correctly
Promotional banner with Edu9 contact info (9133311450, info@edu9.in)
Start Test button launches quiz interface
Timer starts at 3:00:00 and counts down properly
Section tabs for all 5 subjects with progress indicators
Question display with proper numbering (1 of 30, etc.)
All 4 answer options (A, B, C, D) clickable and functional
Answer selection highlights chosen option correctly
Mark for Review button toggles marking status
Clear Response button removes selected answers
Show Hint button displays and hides hint text
Previous/Next navigation buttons work correctly
Question palette allows direct navigation to any question
Section switching between Physics, Chemistry, English, Logical Reasoning, Mathematics
Theme toggle (dark/light mode) functionality
Submit Test button shows confirmation modal with statistics
Results screen displays total marks, percentage, and section-wise breakdown
Restart functionality returns to start screen
Backend API: Root endpoint (/api/) responds correctly
Backend API: Quiz sections configuration (130 questions, 390 marks, 180 minutes)
Backend API: All questions endpoint returns 130 questions across 5 sections
Backend API: Individual section endpoints return correct question counts
Backend API: Quiz submission with proper scoring calculation
Backend API: Correct answers endpoint for results review
Backend API: Error handling for invalid sections
Frontend-backend integration for real-time quiz functionality
Responsive design and professional UI with proper contrast
Security: Correct answers properly hidden during quiz
